description: This file defines the internal static class `SubscriptionMarker` which provides methods to mark and identify subscription GUIDs as either explicit or implicit by manipulating the high bit of the last byte of the GUID.

classes.name: SubscriptionMarker
classes.description: Provides static methods to mark and check subscription GUIDs as implicit or explicit by manipulating the high bit.

methods.name: MarkAsExplicitSubscriptionId
methods.description: Marks a GUID as an explicit subscription ID by clearing the high bit.

methods.name: MarkAsImplictSubscriptionId
methods.description: Marks a GUID as an implicit subscription ID by setting the high bit.

methods.name: IsImplicitSubscription
methods.description: Checks whether the provided GUID is marked as implicit by testing the high bit of the last byte.

methods.name: MarkSubscriptionGuid
methods.description: Internal method that sets or clears the high bit of the GUID's last byte based on the isImplicitSubscription flag.
